notes: Implemented support for SAST gating and SCA and IAST scan data ingestion from AppScan 360. Scan results are fetched and displayed as metrics within Velocity using dot indicators. IAST scan data is displayed only on the Insights page.
Initial Release: Implemented support for SAST and DAST scan data ingestion from AppScan 360. Scan results are fetched and displayed as metrics within Velocity using dot indicators.
